description: Scrape TikTok posts by URL or ID. Extract video metadata, engagement counts, author info, hashtags, music, and more.

includeAuthorStats.description: Include author follower/following/heart/video counts in the author object.
includeAuthorStats.title: Include Author Stats

includeContents.description: Include contents array (segment-level text breakdown) from video-detail.
includeContents.title: Include Contents

includeEffectStickers.description: Include effectStickers and stickersOnItem arrays from video-detail.
includeEffectStickers.title: Include Effect Stickers

includeHashtags.description: Include hashtags array extracted from textExtra.
includeHashtags.title: Include Hashtags

includeItemControl.description: Include item_control object with can_comment, can_repost, can_share flags.
includeItemControl.title: Include Item Control

includeMediaUrls.description: Include signed video/cover/music play URLs in output. These URLs expire within ~24 hours.
includeMediaUrls.title: Include Media URLs

includeMentions.description: Include @mentions extracted from textExtra with start/end offsets.
includeMentions.title: Include Mentions

includeSubtitles.description: Include subtitleInfos, bitrateInfo, and volumeInfo arrays (requires video-detail interception).
includeSubtitles.title: Include Subtitles

postIds.description: TikTok post IDs as strings (15–20 digit numbers). Alternative to postUrls.
postIds.title: Post IDs

postUrls.description: List of TikTok post URLs to scrape. Accepts standard /@user/video/ID format.
postUrls.title: Post URLs

validateMediaUrls.description: Probe each video URL with a HEAD request to verify it is accessible. Adds latency per post.
validateMediaUrls.title: Validate Media URLs

title: TikTok Post Scraper Input
